body.statement: For every finite acyclic directed mixed graph \(\mathcal G\), whenever the recursive ID algorithm returns an expression for \(P_{\mathbf x}(\mathbf y)\), that expression equals the interventional distribution in every semi-Markovian SCM compatible with \(\mathcal G\).

source.verbatim_statement: Whenever ID returns an expression for \(P_{\mathbf{x}}(\mathbf{y})\), it is correct.

attestation.note: Transcribed from Theorem 38 in the JMLR publisher PDF.
